description.value: Spice Hut Indian Cuisine is an East Indian restaurant located in Tofino, BC, one of Vancouver Island's premier surf and cycling destinations on the remote west coast. Situated on Main Street, it offers a warm meal option for cyclists completing the challenging ride into Tofino along Highway 4. The restaurant operates an online ordering platform under the brand Spice Hut Canada.
